decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the proposed development, shall match those used for the existing building.
Condition : 3 - All hard and soft landscape works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and with a programme to be agreed by the Local Planning Authority.
description: External alterations to the existing building to include the provision of louvres to the north, south and east elevations, compressed air and oil disposal equipment enclosure, air handling unit compound, and a retaining wall to gas meter housing, plus alterations to landscaping on the northern boundary and at the eastern corner of the site, together with the retention of the infill of 2 No. dock levellers and other alterations on the west elevation of the building, external steps from the fire exit, retention of a single storey 'delivery bay' extension to the west elevation and a covered vehicle wash bay, the retention of covered bike/motorbike shelters, the retention of a hand delivery cage, the retention of air conditioning condenser units/enclosures to the north and south boundaries, the retention of works to the security entrances including the retention of 2 No. gatehouse, one with a glazed smokers' canopy attached, and the retention of the raised height of the boundary fencing to provide anti-intrusion capability.
